translations.translatedText: # Friday 3.6.2022 (radio)

Russia's military campaign in Ukraine has lasted 100 days already. A new omicron variant is spreading in Finland too. President Niinistö moved to Kultaranta. Police intensify monitoring at the weekend. The weather.
## Russia's attack on Ukraine
![Map of the military situation in Ukraine and Russia.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12475944)
Open image viewer
About 20 per cent of Ukraine's area is in Russian hands. Photo: Yle
Russia's war of attack on Ukraine has lasted 100 days already.
Perhaps tens of thousands of soldiers and civilians have already died in the war. Since the war broke out, more than 6 million Ukrainians have fled the country.
Russia is now attacking fiercely, especially in Eastern Ukraine. Elsewhere in Ukraine, however, Russia's advance has stopped.

Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says that fighting is taking place along a front line more than 1000 kilometres long. Zelenskyy also says that about 20 per cent of Ukraine's area is under the control of Russian forces.
## New omicron variant

![A test tube with the word omicron written on a sticker, with a school class and a teacher in the background.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5568,h_3132,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-90214361e17ce9d093d/1642167673)
Open image viewer
A sub-variant of the omicron virus is spreading in the Helsinki and Turku region. Photo: ullstein bild/ All Over Press
A new corona variant is spreading here and in the world. It looks like a new sub-variant of the omicron virus, BA.5, is already spreading at least in the Helsinki and Turku region.

The Helsinki and Uusimaa hospital district HUS believes that the new variant will cause a wave of infections already this summer. An estimated 12 per cent of the infections detected in the HUS area are now caused by the new corona variant.
The new virus variant spreads more easily than any earlier omicron variant. It evades vaccines, but it looks like it does not cause a more serious disease than before.
## The President and the Prime Minister's couple move to Kultaranta
![Kultaranta](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-8989962)
Open image viewer
The President's flag flutters at Kultaranta. Photo: Petteri Paalasmaa / AOP
President Sauli Niinistö and Mrs Jenni Haukio have moved today to Kultaranta in Naantali. Kultaranta is the summer residence of the President of the Republic.
During the summer Niinistö will work mainly at Kultaranta. The Kultaranta talks, which Niinistö hosts, will also be held there in a week's time.
The city of Naantali will hold a welcome reception for the presidential couple on Sunday evening.
## Police intensify monitoring of young people
![Young people by the shore](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5538572)
Open image viewer
Young people celebrate the start of the summer holidays. Photo: Yle
The police are monitoring the school end-of-term weekend in different parts of the country.

For example, in Helsinki the police are monitoring meeting places favoured by young people, such as parks, bathing beaches and the yards of day-care centres and schools. The aim of the monitoring is to prevent disturbances of public order, accidents and crimes.

If a person under 18 has alcohol with them, there will be a fine and a report to the guardian and the child protection authority, the police say. The police also take alcoholic drinks away from minors and destroy them.
## Saturday's weather
![Finland's weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12475911)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
On Saturday it rains at times in the east and south. In the west and north it is dry and the sun shines too.
The temperature is between 15 and 20 degrees.
